verdict.rationale: Google's own docs say codes generate without an internet connection or mobile service, and the app offers a "Use without an account" option, so neither network nor vendor account is needed to see TOTP codes; the GitHub repo confirms RFC 6238 TOTP implementations. Community complaints about cloud sync and backups concern different stories and do not contradict offline, account-free generation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of fully offline, account-free use.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes

citations.quote: You can still generate codes without an internet connection or mobile service.
When you first open the app, tap Use without an account.
the Time-based One-time Password (TOTP) algorithm specified in RFC 6238
